notes: Run of 2026-11-16. Two items queued. The Tacos Oscar wire-fraud story names no address. The Databricks headquarters story is about One Sansome, though read.py surfaced only 160 Spear St., the company's first San Francisco office, mentioned in passing.

findings.description: Databricks officially moved its San Francisco headquarters into One Sansome, taking 10 floors and more than 200,000 sq ft, more than a year after it signed a long-term lease there; it plans to add space in the building by next fall.

extra.date_note: The article (dated 11 November 2026, a Wednesday) says the company 'officially moved into its new office Thursday' without a date; the publication date is used rather than guessing which Thursday.

citation.label: San Francisco Chronicle, “Databricks opens huge new S.F. headquarters as AI fuels an office market comeback,” 11 November 2026

raw.text: The artificial intelligence start-up officially moved into its new office Thursday, spanning 10 floors and more than 200,000 square feet at One Sansome.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 1 SANSOME ST → parcel 0289003; sf-parcels has blklot 0289003 active, 1–1 SANSOME; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1983.
